verdict.rationale: Terraform's CLI exposes machine-readable JSON flags for plan/apply/show/validate and was hands-on verified to run a full plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop headlessly, giving strong programmatic parity with interactive use, and an official MCP server also works. However there is no documented REST/OpenAPI API for the Terraform Cloud/HCP UI (openapi and llms.txt probes 404), so the story's 'everything I can do in the UI' claim for the cloud UI is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: documented HTTP/REST API with UI feature parity for Terraform Cloud, independent confirmation that all UI-only actions (e.g. team/policy management) are API-reachable.
